page.layout: One printed page (p. 58) with running head at top. Below the running text, a title block in capitals and a heading "CAPUT I." with verse in the main column. Margin numbers beside the verse on the left. A catchword "Quis" at bottom right. Part of the neighbouring right-hand page shows at the scan edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: & quid tum contigerit : quò pertinet Angeli descen-sus, & eiusdem suauis illa oratio ad ipsas, quòd Christus jam resurrexerit, usque ad v. 8. Deinde quid ipsis abeuntibus in via contigerit, dum in ur-bem festinant ad discipulos : habent obuiam ipsum Christum testem suæ resurrectionis, usque ad v. 11. Tertiò, quomodo eadem res ad Pontifices defera-tur,& quomodo ex eo nuncio sint affecti ;quid item contra sint machinati, usque ad v. 16. Postremò plenius & illustrius exhibet se Christus suis discipu-lis in Galilæa,ubi etiam mandatum videntur accipere docendi puram doctrinam, & administrandi Baptismum.
main_text.head: ARGUMENTA CAPITUM EVANGELII SECUNDUM MATTHÆUM, ELEGIACO CARMINE, à D. Rudolpho Gualthero expressa.
CAPUT I.
main_text.p: Maiores numerat sancti & primordia Christi, Qui fuit è casta virgine natus homo. Multa timet stupida percussus mente maritus, Angelicis verbis cura recedit iners.
2Fœlici veniunt deducti sydere Persæ, Atque ferunt Regi mystica dona nouo. Infantes pereunt, Aegypti regna subiit CHRISTUS, at in patriam mox tamen inde redit.
3Edocet abiectâ Vates respiscere mente, Multorumque sacra corpora tingit aqua. Quæ steriles scindat plantas jam facta securis. Tingitur & CHRISTUS, dat sua signa pater.
4Testiferi CHRISTUS tentatur dæmonis astu. Vincit, & hinc sancto prædicat ore fidem, Discipulósque vocat,quos divina imbuat arte, Et multos morbo liberat inde grauî.

page.notes: The right-hand margin numeral "5" beside the catchword "Quis" at the foot is a marginal verse number belonging to the next stanza and is not transcribed in the text. Stanza numbers 2, 3 and 4 were read from the left margin; stanza 1 has no legible number. The right-hand printed page is cut off at the scan edge and is not transcribed. The printed hyphens in "vr-bem", "defera-tur", "descen-sus" and "discipu-lis" are kept as printed.
